item.text: {"search_note":"I found strong evidence for state and bureaucracy mobilization, but less direct public evidence on Erdoğan’s party apparatus and coalition machinery in 2024 beyond electoral messaging and local-government interventions. The clearest mobilization evidence is in macro policy, investment planning, procurement, and enforcement, not in a full public organizational blueprint for party/coalition coordination.","evidence":[{"title":"2024 Yılı Cumhurbaşkanlığı Yıllık Programı Resmi Gazete’de yayımlanmıştır","publisher":"T.C. This is strong evidence the governing network was mobilized behind the stabilization program.","question_ids":["8B.3","8B.2"]},{"title":"Republic of Türkiye: 2024 Article IV Consultation-Press Release; Staff Report; and Statement","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-10-11","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/publications/cr/issues/2024/10/11/republic-of-trkiye-2024-article-iv-consultation-press-release-staff-report-and-statement-by-556139","summary":"The IMF says authorities pursued tax/expenditure measures, AML/CFT updates, and a new anti-corruption strategy. This is effective enforcement, but it cuts against transparent program execution.","question_ids":["8B.3","7B.10"]},{"title":"Freedom in the World 2024: Turkey","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/turkey/freedom-world/2024","summary":"Freedom House says state institutions and media favored the AKP, while authorities restricted speech and used state leverage during the campaign and after the earthquake. This is negative evidence: the bureaucracy was mobilized to block scrutiny rather than enforce accountability.","question_ids":["8B.3","7B.10"]},{"title":"DMO procurement system statement","publisher":"Devlet Malzeme Ofisi Genel Müdürlüğü","date":"2024-05-03","url":"https://www.dmo.gov.tr/Eng/Home/EngIcerik/1212","summary":"The state procurement agency emphasizes transparency, competition, accountability, and digital e-tenders. This is positive evidence of a functioning state channel executing policy through formal rules.","question_ids":["8B.3","5B.6"]}]}
